content.value_statement: App store optimization requests often stall when account setup or task selection is unclear. This router checks prerequisites and directs requests to relevant ASOScan specialists.
actual_capabilities: Distinguishes general ASO questions and setup requests from tasks that need connected account data.
Checks for connected ASOScan tools or an API key without printing the key.
Resolves account apps and guides setup using the app store link, tracking country, and competitor links.
Routes keyword research, competitor analysis, review workflows, and listing audits to named specialist skills.
Defines API authentication, response handling, URL encoding, and credit-aware request conventions.
Sequences a full ASO review through metadata audit, keyword opportunities, and competitor analysis.
limitations: The supplied package contains routing instructions only; companion specialist skills and connected ASOScan tools must be available separately.
Account-specific requests require connected tools or an ASOScan API key; some operations consume credits or app slots.
Unpublished apps cannot be added directly; the workflow suggests tracking a published competitor instead.
ASOScan provides no install or revenue data, and this router cannot guarantee download growth.

use_cases.title: Start Tracking a Published App
use_cases.description: Guide app identification, country selection, competitor setup, and initial recommendations before choosing a specialist workflow.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Keyword and Competitor Research
use_cases.description: Resolve a tracked app and route ranking, keyword opportunity, or rival comparison requests to the appropriate specialist.

use_cases.title: Direct Review and Listing Work
use_cases.description: Send sentiment analysis and review reply requests to review insights, and localized listing requests to metadata audit.

prompt_templates.title: Learn ASO Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain app store optimization basics and route me to general guidance without accessing account data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: conceptual guidance without an API key.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare App Tracking
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up [app store link] for [country]. Check my ASOScan connection and ask before credit-consuming changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: guided account and app setup.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Keyword Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: For [tracked app] in [country], find the right workflow for keyword opportunities and competitor rankings. Reuse existing results when possible.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: keyword and competitor task routing.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Full ASO Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Coordinate an ASO review of [tracked app] in [country]. Start with metadata, then keyword opportunities and competitor analysis. Confirm paid calls first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: multi-specialist review with credit controls.

output_examples.input: How does ASO work? I do not have an API key.
output_examples.output: Route: aso-fundamentals. General ASO guidance does not require an API key or access to your account.

output_examples.input: My ASOScan account has no apps. Help me start tracking my published app.
output: Please provide your App Store or Google Play link and the country you want to track.
Adding an app uses two API credits and one app slot.
Please also provide store links for competitors you want to track.

output_examples.input: Which workflow handles a full ASO review of my tracked app?
output: First, resolve the app in your ASOScan account.
Start with metadata-audit for listing quality and the ASO score.
Then use keyword-opportunities and competitor-analysis for keyword gaps and rival comparisons.

best_practices: Specify the app store link and tracking country; provide full store links for competitors.
Keep API keys in the environment and avoid printing or sharing their values.
Confirm credit-consuming operations and reuse keyword research results to avoid repeat charges.
anti_patterns: Assuming the router includes specialist implementations or generates account data without a connection.
Guessing the tracking country or sending bare competitor identifiers instead of store links.
Repeating expensive keyword research calls or promising install and revenue outcomes from ASO data.

faq.question: Do all requests require an API key?
faq.answer: No. General advice and setup guidance do not require a key. Connected ASOScan tools also avoid manual API key handling.

faq.question: Does this package include every ASOScan specialist?
faq.answer: No. The supplied package contains one routing instruction file. The referenced specialists and external tools must be available separately.

faq.question: Which stores does the setup workflow cover?
faq.answer: The instructions cover App Store and Google Play links. You must choose the country to track.

faq.question: Can I track an unpublished app directly?
faq.answer: No. The workflow suggests tracking a similar published competitor until your app is available.

faq.question: Can ASOScan operations consume credits?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions list credit charges for app additions, keyword discovery, keyword research, writes, and AI tools. Confirm costs before proceeding.

faq.question: Can this router post iOS review replies by itself?
faq.answer: No. It routes replies to review-insights. The instructions require an App Store Connect connection before posting an iOS review reply.
